body.title: Acc2: requests over the limit wait for a token
body.body:
Requests over a tenant's burst now wait for a token instead of failing at once. `Limiter.take` becomes async: with no token free, the request joins its tenant's queue of waiters (`acc2/src/waiters.ts`, new) and goes on, oldest first, when a timer set for the next whole token fires. A request still fails with `LimitError` after `timeoutMs` (2 s by default), or at once when `maxWaiting` (100) requests are already waiting. `clock.ts` is renamed `time.ts`.

Tests in `acc2/src/limiter.test.ts` (`node --test 'acc2/src/*.test.ts'`) use a fake clock: waiting for the next token, order, the timeout, the cap on waiters, and tenants kept apart.

A fixture for Lo's end-to-end check of overviews. Not for real work.

body.title: feat(overview): retry a call that fails for a moment
body.body:
Adds `retry`, which calls a function again when it fails with an error the caller says is worth retrying, waiting twice as long before each retry, up to a longest wait. Tests for the waits, a call that succeeds on its third try, and both ways it gives up are in `overview/retry.test.ts` (`node --test overview/retry.test.ts`).

body.title: test(e5): image preview safety fixtures
body.body:
Throwaway fixture for checking rozed's image previews on screen. Not for merging.

- `e5/desktop-picture.svg`, `e5/local-image.svg`, `e5/dev-zero.svg`: each `<image>` points at a file on the reviewer's disk (a macOS desktop picture, the default wallpaper through a symlink and a relative path, and `/dev/zero`), as `href`, `xlink:href` and `file://` URLs. Only each SVG's frame and coloured dot should draw.
- `e5/pattern-bomb.svg`: 316 bytes, a `<pattern>` with a 20000 × 20000 tile. The preview should fail with "couldn't preview this image" and the app should stay responsive.
- `e5/small.png`: a 48 × 48 gradient that should preview normally.
